prediction_fields.name: irs_administrative_budget_usd
prediction_fields.description: Annual budget allocated to the IRS for administering the Section 30D credit, including systems, personnel, and compliance activities.

prediction_fields.name: dealer_registration_count
prediction_fields.description: Number of dealers registered with the IRS to handle point-of-sale credit transfers.

prediction_fields.name: manufacturer_certification_count
prediction_fields.description: Number of qualified manufacturers that have entered into written agreements with the IRS to certify vehicles for the credit.

discussion_points: How does the level of IRS administrative funding affect the speed and accuracy of dealer registration and advance payment processing?
What barriers might prevent dealers from completing registration, and how does that affect the reach of the point-of-sale transfer option?
What factors determine the number of manufacturers that choose to certify, and how does that affect vehicle availability?
